newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Howard pulls ahead in poll.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Howard pulls ahead in poll.

text.p: Conservative Australian Prime Minister John Howard substantially widened his lead over Labor opposition leader Kim Beazley in the latest Newspoll, published on Tuesday.

Howard's rating as preferred prime minister increased to 55 percent from 50 percent in the previous poll two weeks ago, while Beazley's rating remained steady at 25 percent, the poll in The Australian newspaper showed.
Twenty percent of those surveyed remain undecided.
Howard's Liberal-National government also maintained its strong lead over the opposition, the poll showed.
The government's primary support increased one point to 50 percent, while Labor's remained steady at 39 percent.
The latest result compares with the government's primary vote of 47.3 percent and Labor's 38.8 percent in the March 2 national election that ended 13 years of Labor rule.
Recent Newspolls have shown strong public support for the government's handling of economic issues.
The latest telephone poll surveyed 1,151 voters around the country over the last weekend.
